description: a tall strong warrior woman with long dark red hair with thin braids falling down her back, two dark curved horns on her head, glowing orange eyes, dark spiked armour on the shoulders and arms with glowing orange cracks like embers, a bare midriff with glowing cracks, a belt of small skulls, a torn dark red skirt with glowing cracks, a long tattered dark red cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, dark fur-trimmed armoured boots, no axe and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the tips of the horns to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
